The studio

Good design is never
an accident.

NoTrash Studio is an independent multidisciplinary creative studio working across design, development, and visual communication for startups, businesses, entrepreneurs, and established brands.

We combine strategy, creativity, and technology to build meaningful brands and exceptional digital experiences. Every detail should communicate clearly, function effortlessly, and serve a purpose.

What we do

From concept to execution.

  1. 01

    Brand identity & design

    Logo design, visual identity, typography, brand guidelines, packaging concepts, and marketing collateral.

  2. 02

    Web design & development

    Responsive websites, frontend development, landing pages, web applications, UI/UX, and interactive experiences.

  3. 03

    Motion & animation

    Motion graphics, animated identities, promotional videos, digital animation, and interactive motion.

  4. 04

    Photography & visual content

    Commercial, product, brand, and creative photography alongside campaign imagery and digital content.

  5. 05

    Advertising & campaigns

    Campaign concepts, advertising design, social creative, promotional graphics, and marketing visuals.

  6. 06

    Creative direction

    Creative strategy, art direction, visual storytelling, campaign direction, and creative consulting.
